comments.note: IFfmpegRunner.ExtractFrameAsync: renamed parameter `ct` to `cancellationToken` and updated the corresponding <param name="ct"> doc tag. Every other interface in the Abstractions folder uses the full `cancellationToken` name (IFfprobeRunner, ICoverImageService, IThumbnailRepository, IThumbnailGenerationService). The abbreviation was the sole naming inconsistency in the WP.

[documentation-forward] IFfmpegRunner.ExtractFrameAsync is missing the platform-specific executable-not-found exception docs that IFfprobeRunner.ProbeAsync carries: <exception cref="System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception"> (Windows) and <exception cref="System.IO.FileNotFoundException"> (non-Windows). It is also missing a <exception cref="OperationCanceledException"> entry documenting cancellation behavior (IFfprobeRunner documents this explicitly, noting the orphaned child-process caveat). The Documentation agent should add these to IFfmpegRunner.cs for parity.

[documentation-forward] IThumbnailRepository.InsertAsync: the input Thumbnail record has a required ThumbnailId property. A doc comment clarifying the expected sentinel value callers should pass (e.g. ThumbnailId = 0) when the ID is DB-assigned would prevent confusion for future implementors and callers.

IThumbnailRepository.InsertAsync: added <param name="thumbnail"> doc clarifying callers must set ThumbnailId = 0 on input; the returned record carries the DB-assigned identifier.

notes: All four Core abstractions are in place. WP-007 (FfmpegRunner), WP-008 (DapperThumbnailRepository), WP-009 (CoverImageService), and WP-010 (FfmpegThumbnailGeneratorService) can now implement against these interfaces.
